snippet.description:
In the US, there are only two FDA-approved drugs that can actually slow the progression of Alzheimer’s. In China, a promising new experimental surgery seems to improve the symptoms of Alzheimer’s in patients who’ve had it for years. 

On the Today, Explained podcast, we look at what this means for Alzheimer’s treatment.
